About Me

Building the future,
one model at a time.

I'm a B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering graduate with a deep passion for Generative AI and cloud-native development. My journey has taken me from quality inspection on the factory floor at Isuzu Motors to architecting intelligent, AI-powered web applications on Google Cloud Vertex AI.

During my internship at Smart Bridge, I developed NutriAI — a full-stack application powered by Google Gemini that delivers personalised meal plans, calorie tracking, and real-time nutritional intelligence. I also led a team to build a LinkedIn-based Job Recommendation System using hybrid ML filtering techniques.

I'm comfortable in English and Telugu, and bring both analytical rigour and creative problem-solving to every project I tackle.
